_note: Every number here is an ASSUMPTION until labelled outcomes of SIU referrals replace it (docs/explorations/evidence-math.md). log10 likelihood ratio: LR = P(signal | claim needs investigation) / P(signal | honest claim); 0.3 doubles the odds, 0.5 about triples them, 1.0 multiplies them by ten. One value per root cause (proposal.ROOT_CAUSES) and level: 'conflict' (a check failed) or 'review' (a check was unclear or a routing reason). 'missing': true marks a cause that only says a check could not run; it adds nothing and is listed as missing, never as clean evidence.

prior.rationale: Share of photo-based auto physical damage claims that, on review, warrant SIU screening. No primary source found for this line: the Insurance Research Council's 21% / 18% 'appearance of fraud or buildup' figures (2012 data) are for bodily injury and PIP claims, not physical damage, so they are not used.

bands.source: Kass and Raftery (1995), Bayes Factors, JASA 90(430): log10 Bayes factor 0 to 0.5 'not worth more than a bare mention', 0.5 to 1 'substantial', above 1 'strong'.
bands.rationale: Bands are cut on the evidence alone (the sum of log10 LR), not on the prior, so the same signals read the same on every claim.

model_only_cap.rationale: Causes resting on a model's judgment alone (proposal.MODEL_ONLY) add at most 0.3 together, and never make a claim eligible for SIU screening on their own (track 2's rule).

default.rationale: A reason code with no entry below (a new check from another track); a warning is logged once per cause until it gets its own row.

policy_on_file.rationale: No policy on file: the vehicle, driver and period checks could not run. That is missing evidence, not a signal.

analysis_missing.rationale: A photo check, damage reading or statement check did not run (model down, budget cap). Missing, never clean.

policy_period.rationale: A loss dated outside the policy period is a classic red flag with few honest explanations; a missing loss date is weaker.

coverage.rationale: Claiming a coverage that was not bought is usually a misunderstanding of the policy.

vehicle_identity.rationale: VIN or plate not on the policy; a newly bought car not yet endorsed is a common honest cause, so moderate.

driver.rationale: Driver not listed or licence problem: mostly a coverage question, sometimes concealment.

odometer.rationale: Mileage implausible for the vehicle's age or the policy record.

photo_quality.rationale: Unreadable or poor photos are mostly light and phone problems; a little weight because evasion looks the same.

damage_location.rationale: Damage where the claimant did not say it was (model read compared in code, so a code verdict).

prior_damage.rationale: Model-only: the damage reading calls some damage old. Capped with the other model-only causes.

story.rationale: Model-only: statement and damage do not fit. Capped with the other model-only causes.

screen_recapture.rationale: Model-only: a photo may show a screen or a print. Capped with the other model-only causes.

evidence_missing.rationale: The claimant skipped a required photo or video: a behaviour, not a failed check.

coaching.rationale: Retakes or form edits after a mismatch hint, found by code from the capture log.

fnol_statement.rationale: The story changed between first notice and the statement.

police_report.rationale: A hit-and-run claim with no police report: carriers usually require one, and an untraceable other driver is a known phantom-vehicle pattern; often the claimant simply has not filed yet, so weak.

keys.rationale: Carriers ask for every key after a theft; a missing key is a common question in theft investigations, often with an honest answer.

claim_type.rationale: The photos do not show the kind of damage the claim type implies; often a wrong type chosen by the claimant.

duplicate.rationale: A possible duplicate of another claim is one of the strongest single indicators.

total_loss.rationale: Severe fire or water damage: a total-loss question first, a weak indicator second.

multi_party.rationale: Another vehicle involved: a routing reason, not evidence.

injury.rationale: Someone was hurt: a routing reason, not evidence (injury buildup is outside this photo product).

loss_type.rationale: A loss type not handled from photos: a routing reason, not evidence.

siu_review_cost.rationale: Dollars of SIU time to screen one referral (desk review, records, a call).

honest_friction_cost.rationale: Dollars of cost when an honest claimant is screened: delay, handling, complaints and churn risk.

recovery_rate.rationale: Share of the claim value avoided when screening finds a real problem (many problems are inflation, not a whole fake claim).
